intro: Shari Stilwell is a Forsaken paladin trainer stationed in the settlement of Brill within Tirisfal Glades. Bearing a surname shared with notable figures in the Eastern Kingdoms, she instructs Forsaken who take up the mantle of holy warriors. Her presence marks a rare and unconventional discipline among the undead under the Banshee Queen.

p: Found among the blight-touched buildings of Brill, Shari Stilwell stands out as a mentor to Forsaken holy warriors. While the holy Light is excruciating to the undead, Shari guides fledgling Forsaken who endure that agonizing path. She aids newcomers seeking their footing in Tirisfal Glades through their early training and adjustments, offering guidance to those looking to secure a place within the Forsaken kingdom.

Shari shares her family name with several living figures scattered across the southern kingdoms, including Daphne, Merissa, and the renowned smith Jordan Stilwell. Whether she was torn away from these kin during the fall of Lordaeron or shares only a distant lineage remains an unspoken tragedy of the Scourge's devastation.
